test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What will be the compound interest (compounding annually) on a sum of Rs. 9000 at the rate of 32 percent per annum for 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 9000

Rate of Interest (R) = 32% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + (R)/(100))T - P

**Calculation:**

CI = 9000 × (1 + (32)/(100))² - 9000

⇒ CI = 9000 × (1 + 0.32)² - 9000

⇒ CI = 9000 × (1.32)² - 9000

⇒ CI = 9000 × 1.7424 - 9000

⇒ CI = 15681.6 - 9000

⇒ CI = 6681.6

**The compound interest is Rs. 6681.6.**
